enrichment.headline: Adds $167,256.57 for extra plumbing repairs at 51 schools on Syserco's restroom project
enrichment.summary: This change order pays Syserco Energy Solutions $167,256.57 more for extra plumbing repairs found while installing new toilet and urinal fixtures in existing restrooms at 51 school sites. The change comes from preliminary change order No. 10 on the CAL Shape Design-Build project. It raises the contract price from $9,669,824.11 to $9,837,080.68.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 4, Agreement Between Owner and Design Builder – Syserco Energy Solutions, Inc., – CAL Shape Design-Build Facilities Planning and Management Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Awards Deco Tech Systems $181,300 to install security cameras at Acorn Woodland and another school
enrichment.summary: The district hires Deco Tech Systems, the lowest responsive bidder, for $181,300, which includes a $15,000 contingency allowance. The work installs about 39 new security cameras, troubleshoots about 3 existing cameras, supplies 5 spare cameras and replaces the camera recording server. Work is expected to start February 26, 2026 and finish by June 26, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Awards Redgwick Construction $847,700 to prepare the Calvin Simmons turf field for replacement
enrichment.summary: The district hires Redgwick Construction Company, the lowest responsive bidder, for $847,700, which includes a $125,000 contingency allowance. The work covers site preparation, demolition, grading and drainage improvements for a new synthetic turf field at Calvin Simmons Middle School, coordinated with Shaw Sports Turf. Work is expected to start February 26, 2026 and finish by June 6, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
